chapters.purpose: Organize the main combinations of initiative, scale, restraint, and internal coordination.
Group distant models, public visibility, wider networks, and the portable public version.
Connect personal holdings, routine exchange, information method, recurring work, competing action, and settling needs.

chapters.working_title: Values, Shared Terms, and Self-Directed Making
chapters.purpose: Organize standards of value, joint holdings, initiative, equal-standing arrangements, and activity pursued for its own sake.
Frame the private base, immediate approach, organizing effort, unwitnessed work, and the limits of exact-data interpretation.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: The ascendant is associated with the approach a person leads with, which is not the same as what they are like.
tensions: The tension is that the approach is frequently mistaken for the whole, by other people and sometimes by the person using it.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that a reliable approach is a real asset rather than a mask.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: A conjunction is associated with two tendencies that operate as a single instrument and are not experienced separately.
tensions: The tension is that fused material cannot be applied selectively.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is concentration.
Two tendencies acting as one produce more force in that direction than the same two acting independently, and the areas where a person is unusually effective are frequently built this way.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: The eighth house is associated with what is held jointly, where nothing can be settled without the other party.
tensions: The tension is that merged holdings are entered for good reasons and are difficult to reverse.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that merging is what makes things possible at a scale no one reaches alone.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: The eleventh house is associated with the wider network of loose ties, where belonging is partial and revocable.
tensions: The tension is that loose ties are held loosely by both sides.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that loose ties carry information and opportunity that close ones structurally cannot, because close contacts mostly know what a person already knows.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: The fifth house is associated with what is made or done for its own sake, without a justification outside itself.
tensions: The tension is that adults are poorly equipped to protect activity with no external warrant.
It is the first thing cut when time is short, and it is difficult to defend in a conversation, because any defence offered turns it into something with a purpose and quietly destroys it.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that this is where things get tried before there is a reason to try them.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: The first house is associated with the immediate arena a person acts from, before anything has been negotiated.
tensions: The tension is exactly that.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that these conditions are also the most available.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: The fourth house is associated with the base a person operates from and returns to, rather than with what is done in view.
tensions: The tension is that a base is judged only by whether it holds, which means it gets attention only when it does not.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that the base sets the ceiling on everything else.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: Jupiter is associated with the area where more seems reasonable, and with the judgment about how much is enough.
tensions: The tension is that generosity of estimate and poor judgment of scale are the same instrument.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that the area is genuinely where growth is cheapest.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: Mars is associated with initiating action and with the friction of moving before everyone else is ready.
tensions: Reading only the friction misses that the same speed applies to getting over things.
Neither the speed nor the friction is a setting the person chose, and neither is a problem to be corrected.
counter_expressions: The counterweight is that a low threshold for starting is also a low threshold for repair.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: Mercury is associated with how information is taken in and passed on, rather than with how much is known.
tensions: The tension is that a method that suits one setting reads as a deficiency in another.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that method is adjustable in a way that capacity is not.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: The midheaven is associated with the version of a person that gets recorded and repeated by people who are not present.
tensions: The tension is that the compression is done by other people and is not open to correction.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that a portable version does work no amount of presence can do.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: The Moon is associated with how a person settles, and with what gets reached for when steadiness is needed.
tensions: The tension is that this material is rarely chosen and is often slightly embarrassing to state plainly.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that knowing the route is practical.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: The ninth house is associated with the models a person holds about territory they have not directly experienced.
tensions: The tension is that a model of unvisited territory is unfalsifiable while it stays unvisited.
It can be held with total confidence for decades at no cost, and it shapes decisions the whole time.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that models of this kind are how anyone acts beyond their own direct experience, which is where most of the interesting territory is.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: An opposition is associated with two tendencies that see each other clearly across a distance and are difficult to hold at once.
tensions: Unlike a square, where the friction is about method, here the two are legible to each other and the difficulty is holding both at the same time.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that separation this wide is what makes both ends visible in the first place.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: Saturn is associated with slowing down and testing a commitment before accepting it.
tensions: The tension is that the checking is indistinguishable from avoidance while it is happening, both to the person and to anyone waiting on them.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is durability.
What is accepted slowly is frequently what is still being maintained years later, and the area that felt heaviest early is often the one described as solid in retrospect.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: The second house is associated with what a person holds on their own terms, without needing anyone else's agreement.
tensions: The tension is that anything held this way tends to be undervalued by the person holding it.

Something that has been available continuously is difficult to price, and people frequently discover the worth of a second-house holding only when a situation removes it or when someone outside offers to pay for it.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that these holdings are the ones that survive a bad year.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: The seventh house is associated with what happens in one-to-one arrangements, where the other party has equal standing.
tensions: The tension is that everything in this house is negotiated, and negotiation exposes what a person will and will not concede.
People frequently report learning more about their own limits from a difficult arrangement than from any amount of solitude, and report it as unwelcome information arriving in an unwelcome way.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that a counterpart supplies what cannot be self-supplied.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: A sextile is associated with a combination that is available on request but does not engage on its own.
tensions: The tension is that anything requiring initiation is frequently never initiated.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that optional is a genuine advantage once the option is known.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: The sixth house is associated with work that is repeated rather than completed, and with the method used to get through it.
tensions: The tension is that recurring work is measured by nobody and noticed only in its absence.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that method here compounds more than anywhere else in a chart.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: A square is associated with two active tendencies that work on the same material without a shared method.
tensions: The friction is structural, and it stays.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that squares are where work gets done.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: The Sun is associated with what a person organizes effort around, which is not the same as what they are best at.
tensions: The tension is that this is frequently not the thing a person is most skilled at, and almost never the thing they are most rewarded for.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that it is the most reliable supply of energy available.
prohibited_claims: what you were meant to do

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: The tenth house is associated with the part of a life that is visible to people who do not know the person.
tensions: The tension is that visible and important are different measurements and they come apart.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that visibility is also usable.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: The third house is associated with the near circuit of routine exchange, the contacts and errands repeated without ceremony.
tensions: The tension is that this traffic is beneath notice while it is working, so it is almost never attended to deliberately.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that the near circuit is where most information enters.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: A trine is associated with a combination that runs without supervision, which makes it both reliable and unexamined.
tensions: It requires no maintenance and produces no friction, which is why it is usually reported as a strength when it is reported at all.
The tension is that unsupervised material is unexamined material.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that reliability is not a small thing.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: The twelfth house is associated with what is done or worked out unwitnessed, where no account is given to anyone.
tensions: The tension is that unwitnessed work is unverifiable.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that some work only proceeds unobserved.

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: Where a factor is missing, the honest form is to name what is absent and stop, rather than to substitute a general statement that would be true of anyone.
tensions: The failure mode is filling the gap.
counter_expressions: What remains is genuinely there.
prohibited_claims: we can assume your birth time

ontology_records.normalized_proposition: Venus is associated with what registers as worth having, and with the terms on which a person meets other people.
tensions: The tension is that a standard nobody has said out loud still gets applied, and the application looks arbitrary from outside.
counter_expressions: The counter-expression is that a clear standard is efficient.
